name: Noopept
summary: Noopept (INN omberacetam, developmental code GVS-111) is N-phenylacetyl-L-prolylglycine ethyl ester. It is a proline-containing dipeptide designed as an analogue of piracetam. Russian clinical papers report oral tablet use in mild cognitive disorders of vascular and traumatic origin. Preclinical papers report neuroprotective effects in oxidative-stress neuron models and increased hippocampal NGF and BDNF mRNA. It is typically studied by mouth, not as a peptide injectable. This record is informational. It is not medical advice.

sahpra.notes: Not named on the SAHPRA May 2026 unregistered-peptide warning examples (BPC-157, TB-500, Melanotan II, CJC-1295, Ipamorelin, PT-141, AOD-9604, Selank, Semax). A SAHPRA-registered medicine for omberacetam or Noopept was not verified on this review. Not legal advice.

sources.title: SAHPRA peptide products public information
sources.quote: Illegally marketed peptides include: BPC-157, TB-500, Melanotan II, CJC-1295, Ipamorelin, PT-141, AOD-9604, Selank, and Semax.

wada.notes: Not named on the 2026 Prohibited List. The 2026 S0 examples name BPC-157, 2,4-dinitrophenol (DNP), ryanodine receptor-1-calstabin complex stabilizers, and troponin activators, not omberacetam or Noopept. Fonturacetam (4-phenylpiracetam) is listed as a stimulant; omberacetam is not.

sources.title: The original novel nootropic and neuroprotective agent noopept
sources.quote: The paper describes pharmacological properties of the new nootropic drug noopept created using an original approach based on the imitation of a nonpeptide nootrope structure by means of the short-peptide design. In particular, the structure of pyracetam was designed using dipeptide nootropes.
